name: Card art and copies
what: Asks for a spread of cards, checks each has art that matches its subject (no placeholder, no watermark) and that a copied card carries its full text. A bad picture is painted again.
schedule: with the house lanes at 03:00, 09:00, 15:00, 21:00 UTC
last: Asked 6 cards. 2 had a problem: "chocolate chip cookies recipe": placeholder, no art; "lasagna recipe": placeholder, no art. Still without good art: chocolate chip cookies recipe, lasagna recipe.

cost.note: No model call from this guard. A repaint inside the free share costs nothing.
